### Diff-aware (automatic when on a feature branch with no URL)

This is the primary mode for developers checking their own branch. Read `git diff <base>...HEAD --name-only` and `git log <base>..HEAD --oneline`, then work out which pages the change can reach: route and view files point straight at pages; component and style files point at every page that uses them; services, models, config and prompt templates point at the pages whose features depend on them.

Open the app (supplied URL, a local dev port, or a staging/preview URL; ask if none respond) and test each of those pages in the browser, plus adjacent pages a user would pass through. When the mapping comes up empty, the change still runs inside the app, so fall back to Quick mode in the browser: homepage plus the top five navigation targets, with the console checked on each.

Report what you tested, page by page, with screenshots.
